column1: # Servien to Sabran, Carignan 1 Dec 1632 (postscript 14 Dec), BnF Baluze 155 f.123 (copy A) and its duplicate f.127
# (copy B): the two PLAINTEXTS as printed in parallel by S. Tomokiyo, Cryptiana servien.htm, "Two Plaintexts in
# Parallel" (first posted 29 May 2021), lines (a)-(k), with his real wording differences. Braces = words in clear in that
# copy (his italics; plus "polidor"/"grotesque" and "pour ces effect", which his introduction lists as clear). "endur?"
# and the bracketed editorial letters are given without the marks. Used only to build the semi-synthetic TT-PAIR control
# (tools/tests/cipher_pair_control.py): the cipher symbols themselves are images on his page, not transcribed here.

{sans que} le secours qu'ils prometront {puisse}
